role: arm F, primary: each model in each seat against the publicly drawn firm population (P2)
claim_status: confirmatory: the plan's declared contrasts only, on the admitted pack
billing: subscription logins; cost is the list price of the tokens, not a charge
tools: none: Claude Code with --tools ""; Codex with its acting features disabled, and a call that uses a tool is refused

stops.list_price: no negotiation starts once the campaign's list-price total reaches max_cost_usd_total
stops.wall_time: no negotiation starts after max_wall_minutes from the start of the run
stops.halt: no negotiation starts after 5 consecutive operational failures (DC-T-08)
stops.per_move: a CLI call that exceeds timeout_seconds fails its negotiation; one attempt a move

missingness: a negotiation that ends in an operational failure, or is not started, is typed missing; never rerun or replaced

drawn_public_v1.drawn_by: the public world and the seat alone, never a hidden type (DC-D-32); the other side is not told which

scripted_negotiator.reads: its own seat's information: its own costs, the other side's as the declared types and odds, and the moves; never a note

inputs.pilot_source: datacenter_agreement_confirm_pilot_v1 (plan a27bf4fc3738): arm F on agreement_admitted_pilot_v1, two plays a world

record.method: paired t on per-world differences: the smallest n with n >= ((t(n-1, 1-alpha/2) + z(power)) * sd / effect)^2, then n / (1 - attrition) rounded up
